overrides.scope: SRD_CC_v5.2.1.md (authoritative source cross-check, OCR normalization, table reformatting, and layout cleanup)
overrides.observed: MinerU PDF-to-markdown OCR and conversion anomalies identified via systematic cross-check against PyMuPDF direct PDF text stream (SRD_CC_v5.2.1.txt): 33 currency OCR errors ('I GP', 'II GP', 'I SP', 'I CP', 'I,200 GP', 'I5 GP', 'I2 GP'), 15 duration/measurement errors ('I minute', 'Duration: I round', 'deals I Bludgeoning damage'), 4 numbered headings ('# Step I:' -> '# Step 1:'), 12 spell header misspellings ('Component:' -> 'Components:'), 4 spurious markdown headings in spell/monster blocks ('# Components: V', '# Resistances Cold', '# Resistances Acid', '# Senses Passive Perception 10'), 5 glued compound words ('castLightning', 'castPolymorph', 'aBlack Bear', 'aGiant Wasp', 'aFrog'), 16 OCR hyphenation breaks ('dul-cimer', 'si-phon', 'Un-armed', 'spell-casting', 'addi-tional', 'advan-tage', 'con-centration'), 13 non-standard bullet characters ('•'), 36 HTML entity artifacts ('''), 34 LaTeX math artifacts ($10d6 + 40$, \frac{1}{2}, \mathbf{STR}, \begin{array}), 4 fragmented multi-part tables (Wand of Wonder 18 fragments, Bag of Beans with detached row 02-10, Hat of Many Spells 2 fragments, Sentient Item Special Purpose 2 fragments), 5 headerless tables with detached caption lines, 1 misplaced table (Apparatus of the Crab Levers misplaced under Armor of Resistance), and 586 unformatted/single-line HTML table elements.
overrides.proposed: Applied deterministically by scripts/repair_source.py using the authoritative PyMuPDF text stream (SRD_CC_v5.2.1.txt) as direct ground truth. All 336 monster stat tables are reformatted into clean 6-column / 2-row Markdown tables matching 100% of the authentic text layer. All 250 general, class, and equipment reference tables are reformatted from raw single-line HTML into well-aligned GitHub-Flavored Markdown (GFM) pipe tables. Broken line hyphens and OCR word breaks are rejoined, list bullets normalized to standard Markdown '- ', major chapters delineated with clean horizontal rules, monster stat blocks and spell headers compacted into clean visual cards, and the Table of Contents preamble formatted with navigable anchor links.
overrides.rationale: Cross-checking the PyMuPDF text layer proved that all monster ability scores, spell headers, currency values, and table rows exist in the official CC-BY-4.0 SRD 5.2.1 PDF. Reformatting tables and layout to clean, standard GFM Markdown transforms the document into a high-quality, readable, and structured Markdown source while preserving 100% semantic and structural fidelity. Pre-repair digest: sha256-c7119f099c3a62baee84ceb413790d4facf7c634a22bb406ca19c85020ccee12; post-repair digest: sha256-4f404aabe02bf5d647e1cfe25fbfe204c2d7d941f3c16f14aae58806c23fbac1.

overrides.observed: The markdown contains 17 feats including 7 Epic Boons. An earlier audit flagged 3 boons as possibly dropped by the PDF conversion; cross-checking against the official SRD 5.2 coverage and open5e's srd-2024 dataset (identical 17 feats) confirmed the SRD intentionally includes only 7 of the Player's Handbook's 10 Epic Boons.
overrides.proposed: No change: the catalog is complete relative to the source.
overrides.rationale: Retracts the withdrawn `missing-epic-boon-feats` suspicion; kept as an audit record.
